senses.gloss:
--a sage of great repute; father of मातन्ग;
1: Br. IV. ३१. ९०.
footprint of, seen in the भरताश्रम.
2: वा. ७७. ९८.
(I)--a son of खश and a राक्षस. Br. III. 7. १३४; वा. ६९. १६५; १११. ५३.
(II)--a son of Matanga, and a sage; his wife सिद्धिमती gave birth to लघुश्यामा or मातन्गी. Br. IV. ३१. ८९, ९१-106.
--the आश्रम of Matanga, the sage, at गया where the performance of पितृ s4ra1ddha is an act of merit. वा. १०८. २५.
--fit for performing श्राद्ध offerings. Br. III. १३. १०६.

--a sacred place for performing श्राद्ध in the Kosala country;
1: वा. ७७. ३६.
in गया sacred to Matanga.
2: Ib. १११. २४.
--a goddess enshrined at पारावारतट. M. १३. ४४.
--an attribute of विघ्नेश्वर. Br. IV. ४४. ६९. [page२-601+ ३८]
(I)--is ललिता; the goddess enshrined at Siddha- pura, and at कायारोहण. Br. IV. २९. ४४, १४२; M. १३. ४६, ४८.

(II)--the daughter of ऋषा; gave birth to Grahas, अनुज्येष्टकस्, निष्कस्, and शिशुमारस्;
1: वा. ६९. २९१.
different fishes; (the word reads मीना by mistake.)
2: Ib. ६९. २९३.

(I)--a याम deva;
1: Br. II. १३. ९२; वा. ३१. 6.
addressed as, by ब्रह्मा.
2: Ib. २३. 8.
(II)--an आभूतरय god. Br. II. ३६. ५५; वा. ६२. ४८.
(III)--a Bhavya god. Br. II. ३६. ७२.
(IV)--भगवान् so-called because the क्षेत्रज्ञ has a knowledge of क्षेत्र. वा. ५९. ७७.
--a Janapada of the केतुमाला country. वा. ४४. १५.
(III)--a Vasu; a son of Uparicara and a Cedipa. भा. IX. २२. 6; M. ५०. २८.
(IV)--gift of a silver one during the ceremo- nial relating to the digging of tanks. M. ५८. १९. [page२-602+ ३५]
(V)--the image of. M. २५९. 2.
(VI)--the disciple of शाकल्य. वा. ६०. ६४.

(VII)--also मत्स्य पुराण; a महा पुराण consisting of १४००० श्लोकस्,
1: Vi. III. 6. २३; भा. XII. 7. २४; १३. 8.
styled as पुराण Samhita with details of सान्ख्य, Yoga and Karma narrated by Matsya Hari to king Satyavrata during the deluge.
2: Ib. VIII. २४. ५४-5.
--a son of Vasu. Vi. IV. १९. ८१.
--a son of Vidyoparicara. वा. ९९. २२२.
--an आर्षेय Pravara (भार्गव). M. १९५. ४३.
--not to marry with Angiras or Mudgalas. M. १९६. ४२.
--a R. sacred to the पितृस्. M. २२. ४९.
--for manes. Vi. III. १६. 1. [page२-603+ ३०]
--the birth of पितृकन्या Acchoda1 in the २८थ् dva1para; wife of पराशर and mother of व्यास. M. १४. १३; वा. ७३. १६.
--was Mangala, (s.v). Br. III. ३८. ४२; ३९. 1.
--a Pravara (Angiras). M. १९६. १६.
--कश्यप gotraka1ras. M. १९९. १०.
--a mind-born mother; is लघुश्यामा. Br. IV. १९. ८०; ३१. १०४; M. १७९. २७.

--Mother Goddesses present in वरुण's sacri- fice; nine in number; लक्ष्मी, सरस्वती, गौरी, चण्डिका, त्रिपुराम्बिका, भैरवा, काली, महाशास्त्रि; use of liquor in the worship of the deities;
1: Br. III. 1. २८; IV. 7. ७२; १४. 6; २०. ४६; ४४. १११-12.
consorts of;
2: Ib. II. २५. ६९.
मात्रस्: also कीर्ति (fame), लक्ष्मी (riches), धृती (courage), मेधा (wis- dom), पुष्टि (strength), श्रद्ध (faith), क्रिया (action), मति (Knowledge), बुद्धि (intelligence), लज्जा (mo- desty), वपु (body), शान्ति (peace), तुष्टि (contentment) and कान्ति (beauty) invoked in गृअहबलि.
3: M. ९३. ५३.
A list of मातरस् created by Rudra to vanquish the Andhaka Asuras; the mother-goddess felt hungry and thirsty and asked शिव for food; the pangs of hunger were so keen that they ate of the worldly beings; शिव then thought of नृसिम्ह and praised Him; he created a number of mother-goddesses to overpower them; then all of them [page२-678+ ३४] were blessed to be divine beings and help people to tide over difficulties when they would remember and pray to them; seven mothers.
4: Ib. १७९. 9-३२, ४१-89.

--is वायु; heard the बृअह्माण्ड पुराण from the Creator and narrated it to उशनस्;
1: Br. IV. 2. ११२, ११४, २५९; 4. ५८.
related the story in sweet words as seen and in logical order.
2: वा. 1. ४७; ५९. १११; १०१. 7 and ११२, ११४, ३२३; १०३. ५८.
--resident Gods of Bhuvarloka. वा. १०१. २९.
--the portion of a man's body, which he derives from his mother; this part of Vena's body gave rise to the म्लेच्छस्। M. १०. 8. [page२-679+ २८]
--the आश्रम of बृहस्पति. वा. ३८. ४२-4.
--marrying in maternal uncle's family. ययाति cursed his son Yadu to bring forth refrac- tory sons by such relationship. M. ३३. 8.

--a Deva गण;
1: वा. ७२. ५०.
fought with Utkala in the देवा- sura war, but were put to flight by कृष्ण.
2: भा. II. १०. ३८; VI. 8. २५; VIII. १०. ३३; X. ६३. ११.
--a मन्त्रन्यास in दीक्ष. Br. IV. ४३. ११.
--the wife of Aryama and mother of चर्षणिस्. भा. VI. 6. ४२.
--evil spirits (see मातृस्). भा. X. 6. २८.
--a तीर्थ sacred to the पितृस्. M. २२. ७६.
--a mind-born mother. M. १७९. १२.
--the राक्षसस् who cause fear to children. वा. ६९. १९०. [page२-680+ २७]
--the shortest period of time. Vi. VI. 3. 6.
--the small fish being eaten by big fish; the rule of might. M. २२५. 9.

--originally told by गदाधर;
1: M. 1. १०.
told by जनार्दन in the guise of a fish to Manu consisting of a description of Narasimha and an account of the seven kalpas and consisting of १४,000 verses; he who gives it along with a golden fish and a cow on the first day of the Caitra month gets the benefit of the gift of the whole world.
2: Ib. ५३. ५०-2; वा. १०४. 3.
--(Matsya अवतार्) of विष्णु, being the tenth अवतार् during the deluge in the epoch of चाक्षुष man- vantara for the protection of Vaivasvata Manu. भा. I. 3. १५.
